title: situation.wheeling_recognition_letter.title

gate.none: Civil organisation and correspondence only; no secession-cause claim, slavery policy, security order or protected-population effect.

citations.at: I-2 pp. 723-724, Cameron to Pierpont, 25 June 1861; application at p. 713
I-2 p. 713, Pierpont application of 21 June; pp. 723-724, Cameron reply of 25 June explicitly answers it; [I] four days after the actual application, and only after its news is held

namedOnly: Pierpont is named as the addressee of Cameron’s letter, not as its speaker. Cameron’s authorship is checked against his War Department post.
